overview: Set in the imposing Kaiser Academy—a private boarding school that looks like something out of a Gothic novel—*Nightmare School* tells the story of Vittoria’s inexplicable disappearance. A group of friends—Isa, Michi, and Gibbo—join forces to search for her, discovering that the school is far more than a place of learning: it is steeped in legend, a guardian of dangerous secrets, and presided over by an authoritarian headmistress who is the heir to a shadowy alchemist founder…

title: O'Slaughter Day
overview: The day before Christmas, the Veterinary Board receives a positive A test result from a wild boar shot by a hunter. The young veterinary officer has a disposal machine ready and starts touring the farms in his former home village. The very first farm in Kiuma village is home to the elderly and childless Ants and Minna. For the couple, their domestic animals are a substitute for their missing children and loved ones. At the same time, Ants' nephews arrive with their wives and children. The goal is to quickly deliver the gifts and drive back home to the city. But the farmer Ants announces the situation he is in with his animals, and now he needs the help of his relatives to slaughter the pigs.

title: The Living Tree
overview: On their honeymoon in a treehouse, Noah and Annabelle ignore a local’s warning. They’re soon pulled into a AI-run experiment by a tech giant. As the challenges escalate, secrets emerge—and survival becomes the only thing that matters.

title: Send nudes
overview: Two young lovers in a long distance relationship at the end of the 16th century send each other love letters with a carrier pigeon. But since her parents don’t allow them to meet they can’t fulfill their fantasies together…

title: Stolen Birthday
overview: On his birthday, Ronnie, a lonely middle-aged man, sits in a small diner having dinner with his mother, Julie. For Ronnie, the moment feels warm and real. They talk, laugh, and share the kind of comfort that only comes from being with someone who knows you deeply. As the night continues, small details begin to feel off. The people around Ronnie react to him with confusion, and it slowly becomes clear that Julie is not actually sitting across from him. The birthday dinner exists only in Ronnie's mind. In reality, he is homeless, alone, and struggling with his mental health. When the illusion begins to fall apart, Ronnie is forced back into the world he has been trying to escape. What felt like a simple birthday dinner becomes a heartbreaking look at grief, loneliness, and the ways people create their own sense of comfort when reality becomes too painful.

title: The Body Is  A Political Matter

overview: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.

overview: Heavy is the Crown follows Milwaukee community activist and violence interrupter Vaun Mayes as he works alongside individuals and neighborhoods most affected by cycles of violence, systemic neglect, and contested approaches to policing. The film examines what it means to care for a city from the inside out, foregrounding the resilience and forms of care that sustain communities from within.

overview: In the wake of a devastating accident, a couple's crumbling relationship  faces a profound test as the wife's amnesia wipes away their painful history, leaving the husband torn between hidden grief and a delicate secret.

title: Art of Destruction
overview: We follow the story of The Thinker bombing at the Cleveland Museum of Art, trying to solve the mystery behind it because no one was ever caught. By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

title: Man Hoyanne Premayak
overview: When modern romance meets individual ambitions and societal pressure, a journey toward true love begins uncovering the emotional hurdles of finding a genuine connection.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: The Miracle of the Second Chance
overview: Based on a 2022 book by a 12 year old black girl The Miracle of the Second Chance is a soulful drama about family, tradition, and the supernatural bonds that tie us together. The story begins in a vibrant village, where young Kristine learns the heart of her culture from her mother. After mastering the family kitchen and teaching her older sisters the art of cooking rice and beans, Kristine grows into a determined woman.  Her journey leads her from the village to a bustling nail salon, but her life takes a dramatic turn when her father passes away. After stepping up to take over his work, a miracle occurs: he returns to life, forever changing Kristine’s world. Years later, Kristine is a mother to two children, Lightning and Taffeta, and is married to Cled. To honor her roots, she brings her new family back to her hometown to reunite with her parents and sisters. It is a powerful "full circle" journey that ends in the beautiful peace of a normal, happy life.

title: Wolpie of the Woods
overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

overview: A lonely man wakes up to discover a live fish inside his stomach. Desperate for answers, he follows a mysterious group of men who seem to share his condition, only to find himself pulled into a strange situation.

title: Black Market
overview: When a rival kidnaps Adesua’s daughter and threatens to burn everything down, the crew faces their most dangerous job yet, one wrong move and they lose more than the money. They lose each other.

title: Little Hollywood, Tennessee
overview: Each summer, twenty-four high school students across Tennessee are selected for one shot at creating a full-blown narrative motion picture. For one month, they live like college students, make difficult creative choices, and find out what they're made of when surrounded by skilled peers. On the precipice of the rest of their lives, these students navigate disagreement, impostor syndrome, and self-worth in this coming-of-age film that's a must-see for anyone with the creative urge.

title: Midnight Drop
overview: It’s November 8th, 2004—and Halo 2 drops at midnight, a night that will go down in gaming history. Best friends Adam and Tone are gearing up for an unforgettable all-nighter, but their plans go off the rails when two suburban punks hold up their local GameStop. What was supposed to be an epic night of gaming quickly turns into a chaotic hostage standoff.

title: WELP
overview: An aging Nova moves through desolate boxing gym as fragments of his past drift into the present. Sun-drenched memories of unconditional friendship and his deep bond with Kyra flicker against the quiet of his current world, weaving a poignant meditation on friendship, masculinity and the soft marks that time leaves behind.

title: Pussycat Pussycat
overview: When Jules and Mimi accidentally adopt a murderous cat, the lesbian couple is haunted by Pussy(cat).

title: Peekers
overview: While trying to get into the Christmas spirit Johnny has a horrifying encounter.

title: Eyes on the Street
overview: Eyes on the Street, through three different public spaces in Istanbul, tells the story of who uses and transforms the city and its public spaces, and how these spaces are used. Who truly owns a city's common spaces, and who decides how those spaces will be used?

title: Moth
overview: Eight burning suns rise and fall over a fractured America where digital ghosts, abandoned landscapes, and unstable symbols drift through an endless cycle of decay and renewal. Shut-ins linger at the edges of contemporary life while a solitary avatar embarks on a journey across deserts, suburbs, cornfields, casinos, and simulated worlds, searching for meaning amid the ruins of an image-saturated culture.

title: X-Communicado
overview: A mute emissary with a mysterious past must transport a damaged soul to the netherworld before demons can claim it as one of their own.

title: Жемчужная моя
overview: The story of Alina Chistyakova, founder of a brand of pearl crowns and necklaces crafted using the ancient technique of pearl planting. Alina travels to the village where she spent her childhood to show off her pearl necklaces to her fellow villagers—tractor drivers resting after work, women gathered at a food truck. After all, their great-grandmothers made such necklaces, and not long ago, their grandmothers wore them when they got married… Will the sight of beauty awaken the people's memory? And what will this village comedy of two worlds colliding lead to?

title: Бэркэ
overview: The small village of Khatystyr in the forests of southern Yakutia has long been considered the land of the Evenki. Recently, popular ethnobloggers have emerged here, sharing stories of Tungus culture with hundreds of thousands of followers online. Timofey Ivanovich is over sixty. He is a wolf hunter, and so he adopted the online pseudonym Berke (Evenk for "wolf"). Berke is an old-timer, a keeper of traditions, respected and called upon at crucial moments. Now such a moment has arrived: the wolves have returned. Hungry packs are crushing reindeer and moving toward the village. Berke ventures alone into the taiga to drive off the predators. In his real world, he has only a rifle and a video camera. And in his virtual world, there are millions of views and thousands of comments. This is the story of how a keeper of national myths saves his small people from the scourge of wolves, and ultimately becomes a new folk legend himself.

title: Children Of The Whales
overview: Children from Chukotka tell us about their world, where whales swim right past their windows, dog teams pull ATVs, and, according to local rumors, a mischievous little devil has taken up residence in the boiler house. A cinematic postcard from the edge of the world, capturing a childhood that is honest, funny, and magical.

title: I will pray for you
overview: Revo secretly doubts his faith. When his father asks him to go on a pilgrimage together, his long-held secret threatens to put their close bond at risk.

title: The Vampires of New Orleans
overview: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.

title: Partners
overview: Engaged couple Faye and Peter reunite with old friends one hot Southern night; however, when secrets are uncovered, the status quo of their "straight" relationship is thrown into question.

title: NJPW Destruction In Kobe 2026
overview: NJPW Destruction In Kobe 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on September 27, 2026, at Kobe World Hall in Kobe, Hyogo, Japan. The show was headlined by Yota Tsuji (c) vs. Hirooki Goto for the IWGP World Heavyweight Title.

title: Prayer
overview: In a Lisbon techno club, Abdul, an immigrant worker on his very first shift, is on a video call with his wife Aliyah, who is going into labor and urging him to be present, while his new boss Maria desperately calls for his help. Caught between work’s demands and his son’s birth, Abdul grapples with the fear of losing his job and the challenge of becoming a father from afar, and fights with his strict father-in-law for his right to perform the sacred tradition of reciting the Adhan for his newborn son.  The film Prayer, which explores the intersection of tradition, fatherhood, and the struggles of undocumented immigrant labor, is based on the autobiographical story of its screenwriter, Deo Mahameru. The project was created as a student film within the KinoEyes Joint European Film Masters at Lusofona University in Lisbon.

title: Whispers in the Witch House
overview: Upon moving into the house of a deceased relative, a woman begins to notice peculiar happenings around her.

title: green
overview: Set in the developing province of Bulacan, Miguel returns home to his injured father, Arthur, only to confront all that remains unspoken between them in a relationship they have long outgrown.

title: Sofijah
overview: Sofijah, the elusive and mysterious YouTube rapper from 2006, confronts her troubled past and musical legacy, and finds the courage to return to music— and to herself.

title: Where is Ava?
overview: To protect themselves from a mysterious virus that turns women into men, a family retreats to an alpine chalet. Their desire to preserve the female sex within the family leads them down a path of radicalization. The descent into inhumanity unfolds almost imperceptibly, and patterns of behavior long thought to be outgrown resurface. Better able to cope with protogyny, the children offer a small glimmer of hope.

title: Deep Home Front
overview: Deep Home Front tells the story of the Kama region during the Great Patriotic War. Far from the front lines, people worked to the limits of their endurance, raised children, mourned loved ones, and believed that their labor was itself another front in the war. The film focuses on everyday life on the home front, where people sacrificed their health and, in some cases, were forced to live in circus arenas and orchestra pits. Teenage girls worked as blasters in the potash mines, laboratory assistants tested a typhus vaccine using methods unimaginable today, and more than 2000 housewives became record-breaking coal miners. These are only a few of the remarkable stories uncovered by the filmmakers. The screenplay is based on extensive research in state archives, departmental and municipal museums, and libraries. The production team also recorded dozens of interviews, while the film incorporates more than one hundred documented eyewitness accounts from the wartime years.

title: 111 Echoes from Halifax
overview: Traces the stories of characters affected by the Swissair flight 111 crash, which happened off the coast of Nova Scotia, near the entrance of Margaret’s Bay, on September 2, 1998.

title: Love - Love
overview: LOVE - LOVE is the story of two brothers : Andy, who suffers from schizophrenia, and Jeff, an actor in search of success and meaning in his life. After the death of their grandmother, Andy is left without a « caretaker ». Refusing to live in a group home, he insists on moving in with their father, Bruce, whom they lost touch with after he fled his responsibilities. The two brothers then set out on a road trip to find their father, a disgraced former professional tennis player, now living in seclusion near the Salton Sea, in the California desert.

title: Invisible Imagination
overview: Sarah Taylor grapples with the realization that she, unlike 97% of the world’s population, has no ability to visualize. She has aphantasia, or “mind’s eye blindness”, a condition that makes her unable to conjure images or visual memories in her mind. As an award winning film editor, Sarah has somehow managed to thrive in an overwhelmingly visual medium. To understand how that is possible, she teams up with Anna Cooley, a hyper-visualizer who has a fascination with how brains work and together they set out to tell the story of her non-visual brain... visually.  Through interviews with other people with aphantasia and scientists working on the cutting edge of aphantasia research, they explore the differences in how aphants learn, grieve, create, and remember. Invisible Imagination is not just about aphantasia—it’s a celebration of the limitless potential of human creativity, no matter how it manifests.

title: Crooked Miles
overview: Desperate people receive a mystical gift that grants wishes, collects souls, and creates monsters.

title: Reawaken Man: The Red
overview: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed. But 72 hours after his death, Seok Hwan suddenly opens his eyes as if nothing happened. He soon discovers that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he comes back to life. But there's little time to process his extraordinary new power before a mysterious figure known as Black, who has discovered Hwan's existence, begins hunting him down.  Yet with each resurrection, Seok Hwan grows stronger, unleashing powers beyond anything he could have imagined!

title: Vira-Lata
overview: Odete and her daughters face financial difficulties after the death of her husband, Suelen, the middle daughter, cannot fit into the new routine, Sara, the youngest daughter, believes that the world is going to end.

title: A Man of His Time
overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

title: The Doll
overview: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: The Longing
overview: A couple running a restaurant hires young people who have been released from juvenile detention to help them reintegrate into society. The 18-year-old Yuto is keen to start a new life with their help.

title: Seppuku: The Sun Goes Down
overview: Kakizaki Yuji’s period film is not like the jidaigeki films we are used to. While it deals with themes of seppuku, duty, and loyalty to one’s masters and the shogun, we see very little in terms of action. Instead, the film focuses on the inner thoughts and struggles of the protagonist—who is ordered to perform a ritual suicide—his wife, and their entire household, all leading up to the final moment.

title: Nuevas Raíces
overview: After fleeing the war in Ukraine, several families rebuild their lives in a village in Seville. Through different conversations and introducing us to their day-to-day, Nuevas raíces shows their process of adaptation, resilience and rooting in a land that, without seeking it, also begins to be home.

title: A Girl’s Story
overview: During a book signing in Normandy, Annie Ernaux, 70, revisits her memories of the summer of 1958, when she was 17. That summer, she left her hometown to work as a camp counsellor. At the first party, the head counsellor set out to deflower her. Finding him handsome, she lets him do it, as if against her will... Her body becomes a foreign place for her, an offering to be sacrificed.

title: The Tower
overview: Tereza cherishes moments of being the carefree girl she once was. She enjoys time with her boyfriend, but her thoughts drift to fears about raising Karla. She keeps her worlds apart, but one night changes everything. The Tower is a short film about losing oneself and how life's most important roles are often thrust upon us.

title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.

title: PWRCR33P
overview: A lonely arcade regular finds fame and belonging through a new VR game that places him atop a global leaderboard—until cracks in the simulation force him to question what winning actually means.

title: In Limbo
overview: What happens after death?  After committing suicide, a young woman embarks on a winding journey into the afterlife.

title: Melpomène
overview: Marthe discovers her mother’s death was a suicide, not an accident. At the hospital where she was once institutionalized, Marthe investigates the past—unraveling family secrets and facing a disturbing truth that threatens her grip on reality.

Camp Duval

title: Die Sandale meiner Schwester
overview: A day at the public pool turns into complete chaos when two sisters dive for a sandal.

title: V/H/S/Mixtape
overview: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

title: Bitter Sweet
overview: After two girl's friendship falls apart days before Christmas, one of the girls decides to rekindle their friendship through the sweetest gift.

title: Para atrapar el viento
overview: A young man chases a rebellious gust of wind across the hills as it creates chaos and music through the grassland.

title: NAZA
overview: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.
